importantExclusions: chunk-mapping-worker.ts uses case SHARE, not UPDATE: prepareMappingGroup reads/normalizes/stores outside publication; <=16 parts use bulk key/slot/event SQL. Its mappingEventsTx can still wait on the stream.

Streaming/profile/streamed-mapping/native enqueue/acceptance generally use case SHARE. Upload metadata and intake-run progress use KEY SHARE. appendCaseIngestionTx itself reads revision without a case lock. These writers can delay case UPDATE through stream contention.
intake-run-worker.ts snapshot/progress are separate fenced transactions after S9.1i. service.ts:keepManualOriginal holds UPDATE through putOriginal but appends no case event in that transaction.
areas.ts:commitPackage uses case SHARE before package/destination, no direct case-ingestion append. Other case/source-building/fusion/survey mutations without case-ingestion append excluded.

experiment.hypothesis: A 5250 ms normalizer wait holds case UPDATE in the cut; precompute then revalidate under the unchanged fence removes that wait.
experiment.inputs: Repository fixtures/google-uttam/00-all-google-detections.geojson feature 0 repeated by doubles as 20x100 features, not independent operational records. Difficult input is injected processor latency; no new real difficult file opened.
experiment.method: Actual cut/admission/proof bodies; recording transaction and processor/storage/persistence doubles. No database or actual processor timing claim.
experiment.acceptance: One bounded comparison: baseline >5000 ms, after <1000 ms in every locked scope. Changed destination/mapping/input/proof, forged token and processor failure refuse before persistence; source/raw-slot/closure/attempt/hash/coverage checks retained.
experiment.replayBaseline: S91M_SCOPE_BASE=E:/ulpin-tmp/s9-1m/baseline with test-name-pattern=2000-feature uses saved base sources. Logs: cut-before.log, targeted-final.log.

design.change: prepareProvedAreaImport releases its short authorized-context transaction before normalize/remap/profile. Opaque WeakMap token retains private normalized output. draftCut precomputes; ingestProvedAreaPart repeats proof/bounds/authority and exact input/layout/metadata/destination pin checks under case UPDATE. No contract, hash or key-check change.
design.order: Preparation case SHARE -> source/recipe/profile/slot SHARE -> COMMIT -> processor with no locks. Publication unchanged: destination gate -> case UPDATE -> attempt/item/raw/source/recipe/profile/slot -> destination/site/features -> stream. No cross-transaction lock upgrade.
design.noNewCycle: Preparation takes no upload/package/destination-row/stream lock. Mapping stays case SHARE before job/import/stream; upload KEY SHARE before upload/quota/stream and UPDATE before final source publication; package commit gate/case SHARE before package/area. No new return edge. Existing simulated enqueue/completion/package-commit race tests pass; PostgreSQL integration variants skip offline.

qualifications: Queued before API/openapi checks completed after edits began, seeing stale pins, not a clean baseline. All three changed producers match published pins at base.

Mandated baseline server runner read public data-drive fixtures despite REPO_DATA=false before this KEEP incompatibility was detected. Unguarded rerun stopped. All subsequent tests preload scratch no-data-drive.cjs, propagated to child processes; no further data-drive opens.

Guarded server failures: data-boundary refusals/dependent file failures and missing retained-recovery fixture. Guarded Studio: two fixture-reading suites blocked. One initial Studio guard run failed on callback overload; corrected guard, then recorded the data-boundary failures above.
One development typecheck invocation had an invalid relative preload inherited by package scripts; corrected invocation exits 0. Full checks are not claimed green.
